main_learning_gates.note: Learning-stage thresholds do not authorize deployment; only the unchanged held-out Natural gate can do so.

engineering_findings: A/B/C Stage-C logs show direct_preference_context_adapter hidden-width mismatch: Stage-P 32 versus Stage-C 128; the learned preference adapter was discarded, invalidating final A/B preference attribution.
The main run did not show this mismatch because PREFERENCE_CONTEXT_HIDDEN=32 remained in the main environment.
The ablation archive lacks ABLATIONS_COMPLETE.json and five of eight planned tasks.
NEXT_COMMANDS.txt was correctly omitted because no variant passed both Near and Contact Natural gates.
algorithm_findings: Intervention-aware nominal-inclusive Stage-P sharply reduced nonpositive false switches and harmful ranked switches, but also collapsed conditional recovery top-1 correlation, especially Contact.
Policy-top1 certificate weighting improved benefit AUC, especially Contact, but harm AUC remained near random and no gate passed.
Continuous relative-gain regression compressed predictions near zero against a tri-modal exact-PCD target; policy-top1 conformal overprediction quantiles were about 0.60-0.62, forcing zero coverage.
